attachments.name: medical_plan.txt
attachments.text:
EVENT MEDICAL PLAN
Riverside Founders Race 10K, Sunday 18 July 2027
Applicant: Riverside Runners
Issue: 2.3

1. Event summary
A 10K race with 160 runners, starting at 08:00 in the Harbourside area of Port Halden. An ambulance from St. Luke Ambulance Brigade is on site for the race; the paperwork is attached.

Some background. Our committee has run this race for a number of years and takes the welfare of runners to heart. One of our longtime members is a retired paramedic who usually runs the race herself and is not on duty that day.

2. First aid cover
First aid will be available on the day from members of the organising committee, several of whom hold workplace certificates. A well-stocked first aid kit will be held at the event headquarters, and a further kit will be carried by the lead vehicle.

3. Weather and hydration
Water is available every 2.5 km. The race director checks the forecast 48 hours and 2 hours before the start. Above 28 degrees C the start is brought forward or the course shortened, and above 32 degrees C the race is cancelled. In cold or wet conditions, foil blankets and a warm shelter are at the finish.

4. Transfer to hospital
Should anyone require hospital treatment, the emergency services would be called in the normal way and would make the necessary arrangements for transfer, in line with their usual procedures.

5. Communications
Every first aid post and cycle responder carries a radio on the medical channel, with phones as backup. All calls for an ambulance go through the medical lead, who gives the crew the access point and the nearest barrier to open.

6. Clinical lead
The medical lead is Patrick Doyle, a registered paramedic, who is on site from an hour before the start until the last runner is cleared. The lead can have any runner withdrawn on medical grounds.

attachments.name: race_plan.txt
attachments.text:
RACE PLAN
Riverside Founders Race 10K | Sunday 18 July 2027
Organiser: Riverside Runners
Race director: Tomas Reyes
Reference: PH-71257

Overview
The Riverside Founders Race 10K is a 10K race of 10 km for 160 entrants, based in the Harbourside area of Port Halden. The start is at 08:00 and the course closes at 10:00.

Course
The course runs in order along Dyer Street, Foundry Road Bypass, Garrison Street and Bell Street, all of which are closed to traffic for the race. Major roads crossed: High Street and Station Road. The finish is in Cathedral Close.

Course dimensions
Most of the course follows the older street grid. Measured building line to building line, Dyer Street is about 5.5 m, Bell Street about 5 m, and parked vehicles on Garrison Street leave around 3.5 m. The field assembles on Dyer Street over that width, and the finish chute is laid out in the same street, ahead of Cathedral Close.

Support
Entrants collect numbers from the top of Dyer Street from one hour before the start. Timing is by chip, with mats at the start and finish. Results are posted on the Riverside website the same day.
